title: Endorsement Fee Schedule for the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
The Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package's endorsement fee is charged once per chargeable endorsement transaction. Billing bills it as an endorsement fee keyed to that transaction.

## Fee by package

| Package | Endorsement fee per chargeable transaction, USD |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | 15.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | 10.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 0.00 |

Where the package's endorsement fee is 0.00, no fee entry is written.

## Which transactions are chargeable

| Transaction | Endorsement fee |
|---|---|
| Adding a vehicle | Charged |
| Replacing a vehicle | Charged |
| Adding a driver | Charged |
| Removing a vehicle or a driver | Not charged |
| Excluding a driver | Not charged |
| Garaging change | Not charged |
| Lienholder change | Not charged |
| Rideshare change | Not charged |
| Package change | Not charged |
| Renewal | Not charged |

## Several changes on one day

Where several chargeable changes are made on the same day, each transaction is charged separately.

Hypothetical: on a Cardinal Auto Essential policy, adding a vehicle and adding a driver on the same day are two chargeable transactions, so two fees of 15.00 are charged, a total of 30.00. The same two changes on Cardinal Auto Standard write no fee entry, as its fee is 0.00. Adding a vehicle and changing the lienholder on a Cardinal Auto Basic policy on the same day draw one fee of 10.00, for the vehicle addition only.
